metadata.question: Does the built-up area east of the Nile River in Cairo increase from July 1984 to September 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Collections: Landsat L2 SR. For Jul 1984: LT05, fallback LT04; for Sep 2019: LC08, fallback LE07. If month window empty, widen by ±45 days.
   - Location: Polygon east of the Nile in Cairo (approx lon 31.25–31.65, lat 29.85–30.25).
   - Dates: 1984-07-01 to 1984-07-31 (fallback widened), 2019-09-01 to 2019-09-30 (fallback widened).
2. Masking strategy:
   - Use QA_PIXEL bits: mask cloud shadow (bit 3), cloud (bit 5), and cirrus (bit 7; harmless for L5/7). Scale SR with 0.0000275 and -0.2 offset.
   - Compute NDBI = (SWIR1 − NIR) / (SWIR1 + NIR). Built-up if NDBI > 0.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error:
   - Immediately check ImageCollection.size(); if 0 after fallbacks → C1.
   - After masking, count valid pixels; if 0 across all attempts → C2.
   - If built-up area sum returns null but valid pixels exist, treat as 0 km² (valid zero). If any getInfo fails or returns NaN → C3; any API/collection errors → D.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[31.25, 30.25], [31.65, 30.25], [31.65, 29.85], [31.25, 29.85], [31.25, 30.25]]],
      null, false
    );
    const scale = 1000; // per guidelines
    const totalCount = await getInfoSafe(
      ee.Image.constant(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('c')
    );
    if (totalCount === null || totalCount === 0) {
      console.log('Total sample pixels: 0');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    // 2. Attempt configurations
    const attempts1984 = [
      { col: 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', tag: 'LT05', start: '1984-07-01', end: '1984-07-31' },
      { col: 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2', tag: 'LT04', start: '1984-07-01', end: '1984-07-31' },
      { col: 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', tag: 'LT05±', start: '1984-06-15', end: '1984-08-15' },
      { col: 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2', tag: 'LT04±', start: '1984-06-15', end: '1984-08-15' }
    ];
    const attempts2019 = [
      { col: 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2', tag: 'LC08', start: '2019-09-01', end: '2019-09-30' },
      { col: 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', tag: 'LE07', start: '2019-09-01', end: '2019-09-30' },
      { col: 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2', tag: 'LC08±', start: '2019-08-15', end: '2019-10-15' },
      { col: 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', tag: 'LE07±', start: '2019-08-15', end: '2019-10-15' }
    ];

    // 3. Analyze periods
    const res1984 = await analyzePeriod('1984-07', attempts1984, region, totalCount, scale);
    if (res1984.status === 'C1') { console.log('1984-07 Images: 0'); console.log('C1: Empty Collection'); return; }
    if (res1984.status === 'C2') { console.log(`1984-07 Images: ${res1984.triedImages} (Valid: 0)`); console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels'); return; }
    if (res1984.status === 'D') { console.log('D'); return; }

    const res2019 = await analyzePeriod('2019-09', attempts2019, region, totalCount, scale);
    if (res2019.status === 'C1') { console.log('2019-09 Images: 0'); console.log('C1: Empty Collection'); return; }
    if (res2019.status === 'C2') { console.log(`2019-09 Images: ${res2019.triedImages} (Valid: 0)`); console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels'); return; }
    if (res2019.status === 'D') { console.log('D'); return; }

    // 4. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`${res1984.label} (${res1984.tag} ${res1984.start}..${res1984.end}): images=${res1984.images}, valid=${res1984.valid}/${totalCount} (${(res1984.valid*100/totalCount).toFixed(1)}%), built=${res1984.builtKm2.toFixed(2)} km²`);
    console.log(`${res2019.label} (${res2019.tag} ${res2019.start}..${res2019.end}): images=${res2019.images}, valid=${res2019.valid}/${totalCount} (${(res2019.valid*100/totalCount).toFixed(1)}%), built=${res2019.builtKm2.toFixed(2)} km²`);

    const delta = res2019.builtKm2 - res1984.builtKm2;
    console.log(`Δ built (2019-09 − 1984-07): ${delta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${delta.toFixed(2)} km²`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (!isFiniteNumber(res1984.builtKm2) || !isFiniteNumber(res2019.builtKm2)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }
    const increased = delta > 2.0 || (res2019.builtKm2 > res1984.builtKm2 * 1.05); // robust threshold
    if (increased) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

function prepNDBI(img) {
  // Cloud/shadow mask using QA_PIXEL
  const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
  const cloudShadowBitMask = 1 << 3;
  const cloudsBitMask = 1 << 5;
  const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 7; // applies to OLI; harmless otherwise
  let mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBitMask).eq(0)
               .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudsBitMask).eq(0))
               .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));

  const sc = ee.String(img.get('SPACECRAFT_ID'));
  const isOLI = sc.contains('LANDSAT_8').or(sc.contains('LANDSAT_9'));
  const nirBand = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(isOLI, 'SR_B5', 'SR_B4'));
  const swirBand = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(isOLI, 'SR_B6', 'SR_B5'));

  const nir = img.select(nirBand).multiply(2.75e-5).add(-0.2);
  const swir1 = img.select(swirBand).multiply(2.75e-5).add(-0.2);

  const ndbi = swir1.subtract(nir).divide(swir1.add(nir)).rename('ndbi');
  // Avoid division by zero and apply mask
  const valid = swir1.add(nir).neq(0);
  return ndbi.updateMask(mask).updateMask(valid);
}

async function analyzePeriod(label, attempts, region, totalCount, scale) {
  let hadAnyImages = false;
  let triedImagesTotal = 0;
  for (const at of attempts) {
    const ic = ee.ImageCollection(at.col)
      .filterBounds(region)
      .filterDate(at.start, at.end);
    const size = await getInfoSafe(ic.size());
    if (size === null) return { status: 'D' };
    if (size === 0) continue;
    hadAnyImages = true;
    triedImagesTotal += size;

    const ndbiCol = ic.map(prepNDBI);
    const comp = ndbiCol.median().select('ndbi').clip(region);

    const valid = await getInfoSafe(comp.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('ndbi'));
    if (valid === null) return { status: 'D' };
    if (valid === 0) continue;

    const areaM2 = await getInfoSafe(
      comp.gt(0).selfMask().multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).rename('area').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('area')
    );
    const builtKm2 = areaM2 === null ? 0 : (areaM2 / 1e6);
    return {
      status: 'OK',
      label: label,
      tag: at.tag,
      start: at.start,
      end: at.end,
      images: size,
      valid: valid,
      builtKm2: builtKm2
    };
  }
  if (!hadAnyImages) return { status: 'C1' };
  return { status: 'C2', triedImages: triedImagesTotal };
}

function isFiniteNumber(x) {
  return typeof x === 'number' && isFinite(x);
}

function getInfoSafe(eeObj) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    eeObj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), () => resolve(null));
  });
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
